findings.title: Reviewer 'ask the caller' had no channel for a one-shot subagent, and the packet did not pre-supply verification results
findings.detail: Round 1. A reviewer with a request but no finding could return PASS with [] and lose the request.
findings.reason: Reviewer step 6 now lists open requests under an optional ### Open Requests section and answers WARN while any is open; orchestrator line 128 carries verification results already obtained; sidecar hand-back list names the negative control. Tests assert each phrase in its section.

findings.title: Sidecar reviewer, rule, and instructions omitted that the request itself suffices for simple work
findings.reason: Sidecar reviewer Inputs, rule, and instructions now say for simple work the request itself is the requirement; tests assert it.

findings.title: Guidance negative control did not prove section scoping
findings.detail: Round 1. Both replacements deleted the only occurrence of a phrase.
findings.reason: The test now moves a phrase from reviewer ## Inputs to ## Retrieval, asserts it is still in the file, and expects the section-scoped error.

findings.title: shrink: three similar asset-to-text maps in the new tests
findings.reason: Shared-source paths and generated .claude/ paths have different shapes, so a shared helper would still need one path table per root and would save little; test-only readability preferred. Reviewer agreed the reason is sound.

findings.title: Negative-control bullet embedded a reviewer-only rule in a shared profile and left the term undefined
findings.reason: Bullet is role-neutral, defines the term in plain words (the test fails when the fix is removed), and ends 'report it as still needed'.

findings.title: Ambiguous 'from the rule above' and a mixed lead-in in reviewer Pass 1
findings.reason: The wrong pointer was removed; reviewer Pass 1 test checks have their own 'Also check the tests:' lead-in.

findings.title: Open-request loop had no exit for evidence that cannot be produced and covered only execution evidence
findings.reason: Orchestrator answers each request with the result or the plain reason it cannot be produced, and supplies or denies a missing requirement record; reviewer closes a reasoned request as an unverified limitation. Tests assert both.

findings.title: Pre-mechanism wording remained ([] clean signal, 'ask for it', sidecar 'question' with no Report slot)
findings.reason: [] is clean only when no request is open; tests.md ends 'report it as still needed'; sidecar reviewer raises unclear requirements in its report and its ## Report section lists what it still needs.

findings.title: Tangled reviewer-packet sentence, nested sidecar-rule parenthetical, over-long sidecar reviewer line
findings.reason: Sentence split in two; simple-work clause is its own sentence in the sidecar rule; sidecar reviewer Inputs rewrapped to the file's column style. Round-3 review confirmed.
